name: Housing provident fund (住房公积金)
authority: Shanghai: Shanghai housing fund 2,690–37,302, equal 5–7% each side, supplementary 1–5% each side if elected; 沪公积金管委会〔2025〕8号 from 1 July 2025 and the centre’s 2025 Q&A (issuer host www.shzfgjj.cn does not resolve, 29 Sep 2026). The bounds are the rule of 沪公积金管委会〔2023〕3号 art.17 (https://service.shanghai.gov.cn/XingZhengWenDangKuJyh/XZGFDetails.aspx?docid=230412105807NKYzasRn8VIgegEEV4g): ceiling 3 × the prior year’s city average (2024: CNY12,434, https://rsj.sh.gov.cn/tgsgg_17341/20250918/t0035_1435637.html → 37,302), floor the prior year’s minimum wage (2,690). A foreign or permanent-resident worker joins only by mutual agreement; a pensioned retiree does not contribute (沪公积金管委会〔2023〕3号 arts.6, 21). Each share is rounded to the whole yuan (四舍五入) separately — ordinary and supplementary alike — and the shares are then summed. Kunming: Kunming housing fund: ceiling 32,470; floor 2,170 (category I) / 2,020 (category II) for new, opened and transferred accounts from October 2025; the floor of an unchanged existing account after October is unresolved, so a base below the new floor refuses. Unit selects one equal rate 5–12% each side (昆公积金规〔2020〕2号 arts.10–14, https://www.kunming.cn/news/upload/resources/file/2024/10/12/1728062.pdf). The ordinary employer and worker shares use the same selected rate and are each rounded to the whole yuan (四舍五入). No Shanghai supplementary-fund term applies to this Kunming scheme. Mo Han–Mo Ding category III is blocked pending authentication of the fund-centre floor and account applicability; the centre-attributed January 2026 interim notice and September 2026 report are inventoried in CN-KM05. Fund floor selection uses each worker’s exact recorded worksite; unknown sites refuse, and the Mo Han category-III charge remains blocked. a foreign or permanent-resident worker without a recorded agreement is outside the fund (CN-KM18.optional-participants), so the base, worksite, Mo Han and floor refusals and the `contribution_base` requirement apply only to a citizen or an agreed participant — the participation test `assessed_on` already reads.

name: Individual income tax on wages (工资薪金个人所得税)
authority: IIT Law arts.3 and 6 (https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c100009/c5193028/content.html); STA 2018 No.61 art.6 with annex table 1 (residents: cumulative withholding at this employer — the year’s income less the year’s employee social insurance and housing fund, CNY5,000 a month employed here and the declared special additional deductions, on the annual table, less tax already withheld; a negative balance is not refunded) and art.9 with table 3 (non-residents: the month’s wage less CNY5,000 on the monthly table, with no insurance or housing-fund relief — IIT Law art.6(2) takes only the 5,000 from a non-resident’s monthly wage, and the withholding return STA 2022 No.7 annex 2 item 11(1)② states a non-resident’s wage taxable income as income less that deduction, https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c100012/c5196775/content.html; the pre-2019 财税〔2006〕10号 relief is read for residents only; the STA Foshan bureau’s filing guide Q(十) answers on IIT Law art.6 and STA 2018 No.61 art.9 that a non-resident’s 三险一金 暂不允许扣除, https://guangdong.chinatax.gov.cn/gdsw/fssw_nsrxt_kjxz/2025-10/09/content_00a4ed7054fc4d82ac30702f52001a14.shtml). https://www.chinatax.gov.cn/n810219/n810744/n3752930/n3752974/c3963396/content.html STA 2020 No.13: a resident whose first wage income of the year is paid mid-year deducts CNY5,000 for every month from January (election `first_wage_income_this_year`). STA 2020 No.19: the qualifying continuing employee deducts CNY60,000 from January (election `annual_60000_from_january`) https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c100012/c5194953/content.html. 国发〔2018〕41号 and 2023 No.14: the housing-rent deduction is at most CNY1,500 a month in a municipality or provincial capital and cannot be claimed with housing-loan interest; major-illness medical expense is annual-only and is never withheld monthly. Housing-fund employee shares are relieved in full: the seeded rates (Shanghai 5–7%, Kunming 5–12%) and base ceilings sit inside the 12% / 3× city-average exemption of 财税〔2006〕10号 items 1–2 (https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c102416/c5203070/content.html) — an unresolved assumption for Kunming. Tax is kept to the fen. 国发〔2018〕41号 as raised by 2023 No.14 caps elderly support at CNY3,000 a month for an only child and a non-only child's share at CNY1,500 a month; the year's declarations above the cap times the month (the same year-to-date test as housing rent) refuse, and `elderly_support_only_child` records which cap applies (unrecorded is a sibling's share).

name: IIT on an annual one-off bonus taxed separately (全年一次性奖金)
authority: MOF/STA 2023 No.30 (to 31 December 2027): a resident may have a qualifying annual one-off bonus taxed apart from the year’s wages: the bonus ÷ 12 selects the rate and quick deduction of the monthly comprehensive-income table, and the tax is bonus × rate − quick deduction. Once per person per tax year (国税发〔2005〕9号). https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c102416/c5211524/content.html. A bonus the employee does not elect to separate is an ordinary bonus class counted in IIT. A non-resident’s bonus covering several months (数月奖金) is taxed apart from the month’s wages, spread over 6 months with no deduction, on the monthly table: [(bonus ÷ 6) × rate − quick deduction] × 6, once per non-resident per calendar year (MOF/STA 2019 No.35 item 3(2)) https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c102416/c5202332/content.html. Transcribed into every Shanghai version 30 Sep 2026 (the national rule was in force throughout).

rules.refusal: Record tax residence as resident or non-resident on the employment terms: a resident’s annual bonus (MOF/STA 2023 No.30) and a non-resident’s multi-month bonus (MOF/STA 2019 No.35) are taxed differently.

name: IIT on a lump sum on ending the labour relationship (解除劳动关系一次性补偿收入)

The average is the exit fact lcl47_average_monthly_wage × 12, or unrecorded the version’s default for it; the same series and year as LCL art.47 (owner rule 2026-09-28). authority: IIT Law arts.3 and 6 (https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c100009/c5193028/content.html); STA 2018 No.61 art.6 with annex table 1 (residents: cumulative withholding at this employer — the year’s income less the year’s employee social insurance and housing fund, CNY5,000 a month employed here and the declared special additional deductions, on the annual table, less tax already withheld; a negative balance is not refunded) and art.9 with table 3 (non-residents: the month’s wage less CNY5,000 on the monthly table, with no insurance or housing-fund relief — IIT Law art.6(2) takes only the 5,000 from a non-resident’s monthly wage, and the withholding return STA 2022 No.7 annex 2 item 11(1)② states a non-resident’s wage taxable income as income less that deduction, https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c100012/c5196775/content.html; the pre-2019 财税〔2006〕10号 relief is read for residents only; the STA Foshan bureau’s filing guide Q(十) answers on IIT Law art.6 and STA 2018 No.61 art.9 that a non-resident’s 三险一金 暂不允许扣除, https://guangdong.chinatax.gov.cn/gdsw/fssw_nsrxt_kjxz/2025-10/09/content_00a4ed7054fc4d82ac30702f52001a14.shtml). https://www.chinatax.gov.cn/n810219/n810744/n3752930/n3752974/c3963396/content.html STA 2020 No.13: a resident whose first wage income of the year is paid mid-year deducts CNY5,000 for every month from January (election `first_wage_income_this_year`). name: IIT on an annual one-off bonus taxed separately (全年一次性奖金)
authority: MOF/STA 2023 No.30 (to 31 December 2027): a resident may have a qualifying annual one-off bonus taxed apart from the year’s wages: the bonus ÷ 12 selects the rate and quick deduction of the monthly comprehensive-income table, and the tax is bonus × rate − quick deduction. Once per person per tax year (国税发〔2005〕9号). https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c102416/c5211524/content.html. A bonus the employee does not elect to separate is an ordinary bonus class counted in IIT. A non-resident’s bonus covering several months (数月奖金) is taxed apart from the month’s wages, spread over 6 months with no deduction, on the monthly table: [(bonus ÷ 6) × rate − quick deduction] × 6, once per non-resident per calendar year (MOF/STA 2019 No.35 item 3(2)) https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c102416/c5202332/content.html. Transcribed into every Shanghai version 30 Sep 2026 (the national rule was in force throughout).

rules.refusal: Record tax residence as resident or non-resident on the employment terms: a resident’s annual bonus (MOF/STA 2023 No.30) and a non-resident’s multi-month bonus (MOF/STA 2019 No.35) are taxed differently.
The separate annual-bonus method may be used once per tax year (国税发〔2005〕9号; a non-resident’s multi-month bonus, MOF/STA 2019 No.35 item 3(2)); pay a second bonus as an ordinary bonus.

name: IIT on a lump sum on ending the labour relationship (解除劳动关系一次性补偿收入)
authority: 财税〔2018〕164号 item 5(1) (from 1 Jan 2019, http://szs.mof.gov.cn/zhengcefabu/201812/t20181227_3110164.htm): a lump sum a resident receives on ending the labour relationship (economic compensation, living subsidy and similar) is exempt up to three times the local prior-year average annual wage; the excess is not added to the year’s comprehensive income and is taxed alone on the annual comprehensive-income table (STA 2018 No.61 annex). The average is the exit fact lcl47_average_monthly_wage × 12, or unrecorded the version’s default for it; the same series and year as LCL art.47 (owner rule 2026-09-28). A non-resident’s termination pay is not transcribed and refuses.

name: IIT on an early-retirement lump sum (提前退休一次性补贴收入)
authority: 财税〔2018〕164号 item 5(2) (from 1 Jan 2019; STA copy https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c102416/c5202364/content.html, re-read 29 Sep 2026): 应纳税额={〔（一次性补贴收入÷办理提前退休手续至法定退休年龄的实际年度数）－费用扣除标准〕×适用税率－速算扣除数}×实际年度数, alone on the annual comprehensive table (STA 2018 No.61 annex). The 费用扣除标准 is the annual 60,000 of IIT Law art.6(1) (综合所得…减除费用六万元). Y is the exit fact iit164_early_retirement_years. Owner rule 2026-09-28: law silent on a part year; default the actual years as recorded (a fraction allowed), because 实际年度数 names the real span. Tax to the fen. Item 5(3) internal retirement (国税发〔1999〕58号: the lump sum ÷ months to statutory age, merged with that month’s wage on the monthly rate) is transcribed separately as IIT_INTERNAL_RETIREMENT. A non-resident refuses.

rules.refusal: 财税〔2018〕164号 item 5(2) is read for a resident; a non-resident’s early-retirement subsidy is not transcribed.

The base is the declared prior-year monthly average wage clamped to the bounds. Rounded to the fen per side: the instruments read here state no other rounding (the Kunming 2026 employer notice’s own examples are to the fen).

authority: IIT Law arts.3 and 6 (https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c100009/c5193028/content.html); STA 2018 No.61 art.6 with annex table 1 (residents: cumulative withholding at this employer — the year’s income less the year’s employee social insurance and housing fund, CNY5,000 a month employed here and the declared special additional deductions, on the annual table, less tax already withheld; a negative balance is not refunded) and art.9 with table 3 (non-residents: the month’s wage less CNY5,000 on the monthly table, with no insurance or housing-fund relief — IIT Law art.6(2) takes only the 5,000 from a non-resident’s monthly wage, and the withholding return STA 2022 No.7 annex 2 item 11(1)② states a non-resident’s wage taxable income as income less that deduction, https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c100012/c5196775/content.html; the pre-2019 财税〔2006〕10号 relief is read for residents only; the STA Foshan bureau’s filing guide Q(十) answers on IIT Law art.6 and STA 2018 No.61 art.9 that a non-resident’s 三险一金 暂不允许扣除, https://guangdong.chinatax.gov.cn/gdsw/fssw_nsrxt_kjxz/2025-10/09/content_00a4ed7054fc4d82ac30702f52001a14.shtml). https://www.chinatax.gov.cn/n810219/n810744/n3752930/n3752974/c3963396/content.html STA 2020 No.13: a resident whose first wage income of the year is paid mid-year deducts CNY5,000 for every month from January (election `first_wage_income_this_year`). name: IIT on an annual one-off bonus taxed separately (全年一次性奖金)
authority: MOF/STA 2023 No.30 (to 31 December 2027): a resident may have a qualifying annual one-off bonus taxed apart from the year’s wages: the bonus ÷ 12 selects the rate and quick deduction of the monthly comprehensive-income table, and the tax is bonus × rate − quick deduction. Once per person per tax year (国税发〔2005〕9号). https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c102416/c5211524/content.html. A bonus the employee does not elect to separate is an ordinary bonus class counted in IIT. A non-resident’s bonus covering several months (数月奖金) is taxed apart from the month’s wages, spread over 6 months with no deduction, on the monthly table: [(bonus ÷ 6) × rate − quick deduction] × 6, once per non-resident per calendar year (MOF/STA 2019 No.35 item 3(2)) https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c102416/c5202332/content.html. Transcribed into every Shanghai version 30 Sep 2026 (the national rule was in force throughout).

rules.refusal: Record tax residence as resident or non-resident on the employment terms: a resident’s annual bonus (MOF/STA 2023 No.30) and a non-resident’s multi-month bonus (MOF/STA 2019 No.35) are taxed differently.
The separate annual-bonus method may be used once per tax year (国税发〔2005〕9号; a non-resident’s multi-month bonus, MOF/STA 2019 No.35 item 3(2)); pay a second bonus as an ordinary bonus.

name: IIT on a lump sum on ending the labour relationship (解除劳动关系一次性补偿收入)
authority: 财税〔2018〕164号 item 5(1) (from 1 Jan 2019, http://szs.mof.gov.cn/zhengcefabu/201812/t20181227_3110164.htm): a lump sum a resident receives on ending the labour relationship (economic compensation, living subsidy and similar) is exempt up to three times the local prior-year average annual wage; the excess is not added to the year’s comprehensive income and is taxed alone on the annual comprehensive-income table (STA 2018 No.61 annex). The average is the exit fact lcl47_average_monthly_wage × 12, or unrecorded the version’s default for it; the same series and year as LCL art.47 (owner rule 2026-09-28). A non-resident’s termination pay is not transcribed and refuses.

rules.refusal: 财税〔2018〕164号 item 5(1) is read for a resident; a non-resident’s termination pay is not transcribed.

authority: Shanghai: Shanghai housing fund 2,740–37,731, equal 5–7% each side, supplementary 1–5% each side if elected; 沪公积金管委会〔2026〕3号 of 18 August 2026, from 1 July 2026 (issuer host www.shzfgjj.cn does not resolve, 29 Sep 2026; the 5–7% rates are confirmed only by centre-attributed republications). Each share is rounded to the whole yuan (四舍五入) separately — ordinary and supplementary alike — and the shares are then summed. Kunming: Kunming housing fund: ceiling 32,543; floor 2,270 (category I) / 2,120 for new, transferred and reopened accounts from 1 September 2026 (昆公积金〔2026〕69号); an unchanged existing account’s floor is not stated, so a base below the new floor refuses. The ordinary employer and worker shares use the same selected rate and are each rounded to the whole yuan (四舍五入). No Shanghai supplementary-fund term applies to this Kunming scheme. Mo Han–Mo Ding category III is blocked pending authentication of the fund-centre floor and account applicability; the centre-attributed January 2026 interim notice and September 2026 report are inventoried in CN-KM05. Fund floor selection uses each worker’s exact recorded worksite; unknown sites refuse, and the Mo Han category-III charge remains blocked. a foreign or permanent-resident worker without a recorded agreement is outside the fund (CN-KM18.optional-participants), so the base, worksite, Mo Han and floor refusals and the `contribution_base` requirement apply only to a citizen or an agreed participant — the participation test `assessed_on` already reads.

name: Individual income tax on wages (工资薪金个人所得税)
authority: IIT Law arts.3 and 6 (https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c100009/c5193028/content.html); STA 2018 No.61 art.6 with annex table 1 (residents: cumulative withholding at this employer — the year’s income less the year’s employee social insurance and housing fund, CNY5,000 a month employed here and the declared special additional deductions, on the annual table, less tax already withheld; a negative balance is not refunded) and art.9 with table 3 (non-residents: the month’s wage less CNY5,000 on the monthly table, with no insurance or housing-fund relief — IIT Law art.6(2) takes only the 5,000 from a non-resident’s monthly wage, and the withholding return STA 2022 No.7 annex 2 item 11(1)② states a non-resident’s wage taxable income as income less that deduction, https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c100012/c5196775/content.html; the pre-2019 财税〔2006〕10号 relief is read for residents only; the STA Foshan bureau’s filing guide Q(十) answers on IIT Law art.6 and STA 2018 No.61 art.9 that a non-resident’s 三险一金 暂不允许扣除, https://guangdong.chinatax.gov.cn/gdsw/fssw_nsrxt_kjxz/2025-10/09/content_00a4ed7054fc4d82ac30702f52001a14.shtml). https://www.chinatax.gov.cn/n810219/n810744/n3752930/n3752974/c3963396/content.html STA 2020 No.13: a resident whose first wage income of the year is paid mid-year deducts CNY5,000 for every month from January (election `first_wage_income_this_year`). STA 2020 No.19: the qualifying continuing employee deducts CNY60,000 from January (election `annual_60000_from_january`) https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c100012/c5194953/content.html. 国发〔2018〕41号 and 2023 No.14: the housing-rent deduction is at most CNY1,500 a month in a municipality or provincial capital and cannot be claimed with housing-loan interest; major-illness medical expense is annual-only and is never withheld monthly. Housing-fund employee shares are relieved in full: the seeded rates (Shanghai 5–7%, Kunming 5–12%) and base ceilings sit inside the 12% / 3× city-average exemption of 财税〔2006〕10号 items 1–2 (https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c102416/c5203070/content.html) — an unresolved assumption for Kunming. Tax is kept to the fen. 国发〔2018〕41号 as raised by 2023 No.14 caps elderly support at CNY3,000 a month for an only child and a non-only child's share at CNY1,500 a month; the year's declarations above the cap times the month (the same year-to-date test as housing rent) refuse, and `elderly_support_only_child` records which cap applies (unrecorded is a sibling's share).

name: IIT on an annual one-off bonus taxed separately (全年一次性奖金)
authority: MOF/STA 2023 No.30 (to 31 December 2027): a resident may have a qualifying annual one-off bonus taxed apart from the year’s wages: the bonus ÷ 12 selects the rate and quick deduction of the monthly comprehensive-income table, and the tax is bonus × rate − quick deduction. Once per person per tax year (国税发〔2005〕9号). https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c102416/c5211524/content.html. A bonus the employee does not elect to separate is an ordinary bonus class counted in IIT. A non-resident’s bonus covering several months (数月奖金) is taxed apart from the month’s wages, spread over 6 months with no deduction, on the monthly table: [(bonus ÷ 6) × rate − quick deduction] × 6, once per non-resident per calendar year (MOF/STA 2019 No.35 item 3(2)) https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c102416/c5202332/content.html. Transcribed into every Shanghai version 30 Sep 2026 (the national rule was in force throughout).

rules.refusal: Record tax residence as resident or non-resident on the employment terms: a resident’s annual bonus (MOF/STA 2023 No.30) and a non-resident’s multi-month bonus (MOF/STA 2019 No.35) are taxed differently.
The separate annual-bonus method may be used once per tax year (国税发〔2005〕9号; a non-resident’s multi-month bonus, MOF/STA 2019 No.35 item 3(2)); pay a second bonus as an ordinary bonus.

name: IIT on a lump sum on ending the labour relationship (解除劳动关系一次性补偿收入)
authority: 财税〔2018〕164号 item 5(1) (from 1 Jan 2019, http://szs.mof.gov.cn/zhengcefabu/201812/t20181227_3110164.htm): a lump sum a resident receives on ending the labour relationship (economic compensation, living subsidy and similar) is exempt up to three times the local prior-year average annual wage; the excess is not added to the year’s comprehensive income and is taxed alone on the annual comprehensive-income table (STA 2018 No.61 annex). The average is the exit fact lcl47_average_monthly_wage × 12, or unrecorded the version’s default for it; the same series and year as LCL art.47 (owner rule 2026-09-28). A non-resident’s termination pay is not transcribed and refuses.

name: IIT on an early-retirement lump sum (提前退休一次性补贴收入)
authority: 财税〔2018〕164号 item 5(2) (from 1 Jan 2019; STA copy https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c102416/c5202364/content.html, re-read 29 Sep 2026): 应纳税额={〔（一次性补贴收入÷办理提前退休手续至法定退休年龄的实际年度数）－费用扣除标准〕×适用税率－速算扣除数}×实际年度数, alone on the annual comprehensive table (STA 2018 No.61 annex). The 费用扣除标准 is the annual 60,000 of IIT Law art.6(1) (综合所得…减除费用六万元). Y is the exit fact iit164_early_retirement_years. Owner rule 2026-09-28: law silent on a part year; default the actual years as recorded (a fraction allowed), because 实际年度数 names the real span. Tax to the fen. Item 5(3) internal retirement (国税发〔1999〕58号: the lump sum ÷ months to statutory age, merged with that month’s wage on the monthly rate) is transcribed separately as IIT_INTERNAL_RETIREMENT. A non-resident refuses.

rules.refusal: 财税〔2018〕164号 item 5(2) is read for a resident; a non-resident’s early-retirement subsidy is not transcribed.
财税〔2018〕164号 item 5(2): record iit164_early_retirement_years, the actual years from the early-retirement formalities to statutory retirement age, on the exit.
